description: Define a small domain-neutral boundary that can represent workforce resource use, genomic workflows and MCHS weighted activity without making their meanings interchangeable.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/microcosting_healthworkforce: conditions/source contract and exact Fraction-like arithmetic cases.
edithatogo/microcosting_genomics: one source-qualified assay/workflow and historical workbook evidence.
edithatogo/mchs: classification edition and activity/funding contract.

verification.scope: Contract0.1 schemas, exact values, five independent synthetic references and provider field mappings are implemented. Wider correction/interval/capital profiles and complete provider preservation remain open. The 14 November increment adds bounded 0.2 incomplete instrument-capacity semantics and five synthetic genomics candidates; original 0.1 digests remain unchanged. See the separate increment evidence; broader provider and economic qualification remains open.

completion_evidence: A resource quotation and an activity-kind quotation can be represented distinctly; incompatible kinds/units are rejected.
A nonterminating fractional duration and decimal quotation survive transport without a binary-float round trip.
Rate applicability uses explicit half-open intervals and separates effective dates, knowledge dates and economic price year.
Fixtures distinguish missing, zero, synthetic, observed and unsupported inputs, and preserve source/access/validation states separately.
Fixtures cover sub-cent allocation with residuals, loaded-rate component duplication, duplicate resource-use identity and alternative capital treatments.
Expected values are independently derived, with source and calculation notes; old package output alone is not the oracle.
